caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #121: IMPECUNIOUS

impecunious (adjective): having little or no money.

✅ In a sentence: The impecunious artist painted on cardboard because canvas cost too much.
✅ Similar: poor, penniless, destitute
✅ Remember it: Latin pecunia = money (pecuniary = about money).
